title: Towards WinoQueer: Developing a Benchmark for Anti-Queer Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the pseudo-log-likelihood of masked language models on paired template sentences (more stereotypical/straight vs. less stereotypical/queer) using the custom WinoQueer benchmark to quantify homophobic and transphobic stereotypes.
Evaluating coreference resolution performance on the Gendered Ambiguous Pronouns (GAP) dataset to measure the binary gender disparity in F1 scores between she/her and he/him pronouns.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
